LanguageData.RW_BusinessOpenDesc: Toggle whether new storage offers and vault intel arrive. Closing never cancels existing contracts.
LanguageData.RW_OpenManagementDesc: Open the rental warehouse management tab.
LanguageData.RW_InDebtWarning: Unpaid debt: new contracts are suspended.
LanguageData.RW_NoOffers: No offers at the moment. Offers arrive every one to three days while the business is open.
LanguageData.RW_Requires: Needs {1} {0} slot(s) for {2} days, counted from when every crate is stored.
LanguageData.RW_FeeLine: Fee {0} silver/day while stored; completion bonus up to {1}; total at most {2} silver.
LanguageData.RW_CompensationLine: Lost crates: you owe {0}% of their value, capped at {1} silver. Opened crates: 100% of their value.
LanguageData.RW_RaidLine: Up to {0} raid(s) aimed at the cargo, about {1}× normal threat points, by {2}.
LanguageData.RW_RaidRules: Raids start at least 1 day apart and wait while enemies are present or within half a day of another raid; a raid that cannot start within 2 days is skipped and lowers the completion bonus.
LanguageData.RW_RaidNoneScheduled: No raid is scheduled, but ordinary raids can still happen.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_Accepted: Contract {0} accepted. Cargo arrives in one day.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NotOffered: That offer is no longer available.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_TooHeavy: A crate may weigh at most 35 kg.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_InDebt: Settle your warehouse debt before taking new contracts.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_FactionBlocked: This faction refuses to deal with you for now.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_TooManyContracts: You already have the maximum number of contracts.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NoCapacity: Not enough free, valid storage slots here (slots promised to other accepted contracts are reserved).
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NoReception: Build a warehouse reception desk on this map first.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NotHomeMap: Contracts can only be accepted for one of your home maps.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NotReturnable: This contract cannot be returned now.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_NotReturning: Crates can be returned only after the term ends or an early return is requested.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_CargoNotHeld: That crate is no longer held.
LanguageData.RW_Cancel_DepositorHostile: Cancelled before arrival: the depositor turned hostile.
LanguageData.RW_Cancel_DepositorGone: Cancelled: the depositor no longer exists.
LanguageData.RW_Cancel_MapAbandoned: Cancelled before arrival: the storage map was abandoned.
LanguageData.RW_Cancel_MissingDefs: Cancelled: the cargo contains items that no longer exist.
LanguageData.RW_CrateStolen: Stolen. Counts toward your wealth until opened.
LanguageData.RW_FeeStop_NotInStorage: not in a rack or vault
LanguageData.RW_FeeStop_WrongFacility: this cargo must be kept in a vault
LanguageData.RW_FeeStop_NoRoof: the storage is not fully roofed
LanguageData.RW_EmbezzleDesc: Break the seal and take the contents. The owner will demand the full value and relations drop sharply.
LanguageData.RW_EmbezzleConfirm: Open this crate held for another faction?\n\nThis is embezzlement: you will owe 100% of its declared value ({0} silver) at settlement and the owner's goodwill falls by {1} instead of the usual loss penalty.
LanguageData.RW_OpenCrateDesc: Break the seal and unpack the contents here.
LanguageData.RW_Letter_Delivery: The cargo for contract {0} ({1} crate(s)) has landed. Store every crate in a valid rack or vault within one day; the term starts when all are stored.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_PaymentPosted: Contract {0}: {1} silver added to your claimable balance.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_EffectAbandoned: Rental Warehouse: an action failed repeatedly and was abandoned ({0}). Nothing was granted in its place.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_MissingDefs: Rental Warehouse: crate contents refer to missing items ({0}). They were skipped.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_LedgerUnreadable: Rental Warehouse: the warehouse ledger in this save could not be read{0}. It is kept unchanged and the warehouse is paused.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_LedgerFromNewerVersion: Rental Warehouse: this save was made with a newer version of the mod{0}.
LanguageData.RW_StoreWithin: Store every crate within {0} or the contract ends without income.
LanguageData.RW_ContractMoney: Daily fee {0} silver | earned so far {1} | claimable {2} | claimed {3}
LanguageData.RW_CancelConfirm: Cancel contract {0}? Nothing is owed before the cargo arrives.
LanguageData.RW_EarlyReturnConfirm: Return contract {0} early? You lose the completion bonus and pay a cancellation fee of {1} silver from your earnings. Compensation for crates already lost still applies.
LanguageData.RW_SendReturnPodDesc: Send the loaded crates back to their owner. Only sent crates count as returned.
LanguageData.RW_SendReturnPodConfirm: Send {0} crate(s) now? {1} crate(s) of this contract are still outstanding; anything not returned by the deadline is settled as lost.
LanguageData.RW_ReturnPodEmpty: No crates of this contract are loaded.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_ReturnPodArrived: The return pod for contract {0} has landed. Haul the crates into it, then send it.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_ReturnPodLost: The return pod for contract {0} was destroyed. You may request another; the deadline does not change.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_PodAlreadyActive: A return pod for this contract is already on its way or waiting.
LanguageData.RW_BalanceFromLostMaps: Includes {0} silver earned on maps that no longer exist; it can be claimed at any base.
LanguageData.RW_RefuseDebtConfirm: Refuse the debt to {0}? Their goodwill drops by {1} and they will offer you no contracts for {2} days. Contracts already running continue.
LanguageData.RW_SettlementLine: fees {0} + bonus {1} − cancel fee {2} − compensation {3} → credit {4}, debt {5}, goodwill {6}
LanguageData.RW_Reject_InvalidDestination: No valid delivery point; the balance is kept. Choose another map or clear a landing spot.
LanguageData.RW_Letter_CargoRaid: {0} have come for the cargo of contract {1} ({2} raider(s)). They will grab crates that are not locked in an intact vault and run for the map edge. Crates carried off the map are lost; take them back before that and the contract continues.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_CrateCarried: Raiders are carrying a crate of contract {0} toward the map edge!
LanguageData.RW_NoSites: No vault intel yet. Intel arrives every three to twelve days while the business is open.
LanguageData.RW_SiteNotHostile: This faction is not hostile to you. Attacking makes it hostile.
LanguageData.RW_SiteLoot: {0} sealed crate(s), roughly {1} silver in total.
LanguageData.RW_SiteVaults: {0} vault(s); each takes about {1} of unlocking work by an unskilled crafter.
LanguageData.RW_SiteWithdraw: The owner clears the site out in {0} (not while your people are there).
LanguageData.RW_Letter_SiteFound:
You learned of a vault compound:
{0}
LanguageData.RW_Letter_SiteEntered: Your people have entered {0}. Stock, guards and vault progress are kept if you leave and come back. The owner clears the site out in {1}.
LanguageData.RW_Site_NoTile: Vault intel arrived, but no reachable empty land was found for the site.
LanguageData.RW_Site_NoFaction: Vault intel arrived, but no suitable faction runs a vault right now.
LanguageData.RW_Site_NoGuards: Vault intel arrived, but no vault of any size could be guarded.
LanguageData.RW_Reject_SiteClosed: That site has been cleared out.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_VaultOpened: The vault is open. Carry the crates out or open them here.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_ForcedOpenLoss: Forcing the vault destroyed {0} crate(s) inside.
LanguageData.RW_Letter_Reinforcement: The vault alarm brought reinforcements from {0} ({1} fighter(s)).
LanguageData.RW_AttackFriendlyConfirm: {0} is not hostile to you. Raiding their vault will change goodwill by {1} (to the hostile level {2}) and make them your enemy. Continue?
LanguageData.RW_Diag_MapVanished: Rental Warehouse: the storage map of contract {0} disappeared without being abandoned. The contract was cancelled without penalty; earned fees are kept.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_DepositorGone: The depositor of contract {0} no longer exists. The contract was cancelled without penalty; earned fees are kept.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_CancelledDepositorHostile: The depositor of contract {0} turned hostile before the cargo arrived. The contract was cancelled without penalty.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_CancelledMapAbandoned: Contract {0} was cancelled without penalty because its storage map was abandoned before the cargo arrived.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_DuplicateId: Rental Warehouse: two contracts share the ID {0}. The later one was set aside and is ignored.
LanguageData.RW_Diag_DuplicateCrate: Rental Warehouse: a second crate claimed the ID {0}. It was detached from the ledger and is worth nothing.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_DepositorHostile: The depositor of contract {0} turned hostile. Return the cargo within 3 days without penalty, or it is settled as lost.
LanguageData.RW_AbandonWarning: This map holds cargo under storage contracts. If you abandon it, every crate not yet returned is settled as lost (compensation owed, goodwill penalty). Abandon anyway?
LanguageData.RW_Set_Sites: Receive intel on other factions' vault sites
LanguageData.RW_Set_NonHostileSitesDesc: Raiding them makes the faction hostile; you are asked before going.
LanguageData.RW_Set_AppliesToNew: Changes apply to new offers and vault intel only. Running contracts keep their terms.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_Matured: Contract {0} reached its term. Request a return pod and send the crates back within 3 days.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_CrateLost: A crate of contract {0} was lost. Compensation will be charged at settlement.
LanguageData.RW_Msg_FeeStopped: A crate of contract {0} is no longer in valid storage and earns nothing until it is put back.
